faq.ordering: How do I place an order?
faq.orderingAnswer: Choose your quantity, tap Add to Cart or Buy Now, and complete your details at checkout. Orders are subject to acceptance and product availability.
faq.pricing: Are the prices and stock shown up to date?
faq.pricingAnswer: Prices and availability can change without notice. We make every effort to show accurate pricing and stock, and your order is placed at the price shown at checkout.
faq.status: How can I check the status of my order?
faq.statusAnswer: Sign in and open My Account → Orders to see your order history and the current status of each order.
faq.issues: What if there is a problem with my order?
faq.issuesAnswer: Please get in touch so we can help. Any applicable return or cancellation terms will be shared with you at that time.

about.heading: About {store}
about.paragraph1: {store} is an online dairy store bringing fresh, quality Amul products to your doorstep. From milk and cheese to butter, spreads, and cream, every product in our range is chosen with care.
about.paragraph2: We believe good food starts with good ingredients. That's why we focus on real dairy products you can trust, at prices that make everyday shopping easy.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectBody: When you create an account, place an order, or contact us, we collect information such as your name, email address, shipping address, and order details. We also collect basic usage information when you browse our site.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to process orders, manage your account, provide customer support, and improve our store. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your cart, and understand how our site is used. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.thirdBody: We use trusted third-party services, such as payment processors, to help operate our store. These providers only receive the information they need to perform their services.
privacy.rightsBody: You can access, update, or request deletion of your account information at any time from your account settings, or by contacting us.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.

terms.heading: Terms & Conditions
terms.acceptanceBody: By using the {store} website, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our site.
terms.useBody: You agree to use this site only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of others or restrict anyone's use of the site.
terms.ordersBody: When you place an order, you are making an offer to purchase products at the price shown at checkout. Orders are subject to acceptance and product availability.
terms.pricingBody: Prices and product availability are subject to change without notice. We make every effort to display accurate pricing and stock information.
terms.returnsBody: If there is an issue with your order, please contact us so we can help. Any applicable return or cancellation terms will be shared with you at that time.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept the updated terms.
